summary: Brag House Holdings filed an 8-K regarding a routine amendment to a convertible promissory note (extending maturity to July 31, 2026) and a reverse stock split (1-for-8, approved at a prior special meeting). Neither event constitutes a special situation; the note amendment has no takeover or activist context, and the reverse stock split is a routine capital structure adjustment to maintain listing. No tender offer, spin-off, or restructuring is involved. The filing is purely operational/financing.
